label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Toll held flat at 127 for four days (3-6 Sep), jumped to 135 on 7 September (48 direct, 87 indirect), then rose by one more to 136 on 10 September (48 direct, 88 indirect) per Ministry of Health case reporting relayed by BNPB chief Suharyanto. BNPB has not published case-by-case documentation for the indirect-death classification. The figure remains unreconciled with BPBD NTT's competing 130 count from 5 September.

label: Displaced / Sheltering
contestNote: BNPB's own figure moved twice on 8 September (72,864 morning portal figure revised down to 70,382 that evening by acting Data Center head Berton SP Panjaitan), then continued falling to 60,572 by 10 September as verified light/moderate-damage households returned home. None of these figures have been formally reconciled with BPBD NTT's competing 96,385 count from 5 September.

label: Homes Damaged
contestNote: BNPB's Data Center puts total identified damaged housing units at 102,384, unchanged since 7 September. Field verification progress has accelerated sharply, from 51,591 units (50.39%) on 7 September to 70% by 10 September; Berton SP Panjaitan said verification is targeted for completion the following week to enable reconstruction-aid disbursement. This supersedes BPBD NTT's narrower 99,568 provincial tally (4 Sep); figures are described by BNPB as dynamic.
delta: Verification progress: 50.39%→70% (7→10 Sep); total unchanged at 102,384

label: Aftershocks Recorded
deltaNote: M0.9–M6.2 range; cumulative count reached 15,156 by 05:00 WIB on 13 September (up from 13,863 on 9 September), with 38 events above M5.0 and 187 felt by residents. Latest recorded tremor: a minor M2.0 event 41km NW of Mbay, Nagekeo (22km depth) overnight 12-13 September. BMKG's Earthquake and Tsunami Mitigation Director reaffirmed the decay-curve forecast of tapering activity by late September and urged residents to avoid unverified information and damaged structures.

label: Presidential Visit Status
deltaNote: Twice-postponed visit finally took place on Day 11 (26 Aug); Prabowo distributed Rp200 billion in aid at a Nagekeo Regency command post.

label: Personnel Deployed
delta: 5,832 TNI + 238 Polri + 903 volunteers as of 22-23 Aug (up from 3,500+ TNI/Polri on 17 Aug)

label: State of Emergency
deltaNote: NTT's twice-extended emergency response status expired on schedule on 12 September; Basarnas formally closed its Flores earthquake SAR operation the same day at 18:00 WITA as the province and all seven affected regencies transitioned into the rehabilitation-reconstruction (pemulihan) phase. Basarnas said the SAR operation can reopen if new evacuation requests or victim discoveries arise.

label: Mainshock Magnitude
contestNote: GFZ Potsdam measured Mw 7.61 at 25 km depth vs. USGS/BMKG's M7.7 at 10 km; BMKG's own first report was M7.0 before revising upward.

label: Schools Damaged
contestNote: BPBD NTT's provincial tally rose to 2,633 education units damaged as of 4 September (up from 2,310 on 2 September), still higher than Kemendikdasmen's own 1,918-unit assessment from 31 August (665 schools severely damaged, ~141,207 students affected, only 37 back to in-person classes and 295 on distance learning). A companion Kemendikdasmen breakdown put severely damaged classrooms at 6,927, with 418 laboratories, 1,928 toilets and 370 teacher residences also damaged, and 48,164 school-community members displaced; 785 schools had requested emergency classroom units (2,908 needed), only 89 emergency tents were installed as of 30 August, and 1,221 schools remained halted from in-person learning. Provincial and ministry counts have not yet been reconciled.

label: Aid Distributed (Cumulative)
deltaNote: Up from 2,165 tons (9 Sep); 1,379 tons via Labuan Bajo (West Manggarai) and 664 tons via Maumere (Sikka), with the remainder via other channels.
